depiction.primary_object: capital letter Y with a single horizontal crossbar
depiction.composition: single centered glyph, flat front view

readings.meaning: money, payment, or foreign currency exchange in East Asia

ambiguity: Shares the same glyph for both Chinese yuan (often single bar) and Japanese yen (often double bar, though single bar is common in many fonts); at very small sizes could be misread as a plain letter Y or an antenna symbol.
task_intents: exchange currency into yen or yuan
withdraw cash for Japan or China trip
check JPY or CNY exchange rate
top up WeChat Pay or Alipay balance
settle foreign currency bill or transfer

reasoning: The single-bar ¥ symbol is universally recognized as the currency sign for the Chinese yuan (renminbi) and Japanese yen. It fits tasks specifically about exchanging, paying, budgeting, or handling JPY/CNY money, as well as general payment tasks for users operating in those currencies.
